boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along Greencastle corridors near DePauw, each paired with one source-supported reason to stop.

cards.title: Browse Beyond the Syllabus
cards.subtitle: East Poplar Street corridor
cards.notes: Follow the East Poplar Street corridor to browse library collections or ask staff about local-history and online resources.
cards.short_summary: A downtown library stop for research materials and community resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s official contact page places it at 103 E. Poplar St. and provides public library services and current hours.
cards.access_notes: Public library; consult the official page for current hours and closure information.

cards.title: Find the Courthouse Square Anchor
cards.subtitle: West Washington Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk the West Washington Street corridor to identify the courthouse that anchors Greencastle’s downtown square.
cards.short_summary: The civic landmark at the center of the downtown square.
cards.evidence_claim: The Indiana judiciary states that the Putnam County Courts are in the courthouse on the downtown square at 1 W. Washington St.
cards.access_notes: Government building; screening, office hours, and room access may vary by department.

cards.title: Locate the City’s Civic Desk
cards.subtitle: North Locust Street corridor
cards.notes: Turn onto the North Locust Street corridor to locate City Hall and its visitor parking area just off Washington Street.
cards.short_summary: A clearly marked municipal destination beside downtown’s main east-west route.
cards.evidence_claim: The city’s official downtown-parking page identifies Greencastle City Hall at 1 North Locust Street and documents its visitor lot.
cards.access_notes: Municipal offices have department-specific business hours; the cited page documents parking access.

cards.title: See a Community Music Space
cards.subtitle: North Indiana Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the North Indiana Street corridor to find DePauw’s community music space and check its program channels before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A downtown bridge between DePauw music programming and the wider community.
cards.evidence_claim: The visitor bureau lists Music on the Square at 21 N. Indiana Street and describes lessons, classes, and performances hosted by DePauw’s School of Music.
cards.source_title: Music on the Square - Putnam County Visitor's Bureau
cards.access_notes: Entry depends on the scheduled lesson, class, or performance; verify the specific program before arrival.

cards.title: Browse an Inclusive Size Range
cards.subtitle: West Washington Street corridor
cards.notes: Continue along the West Washington Street corridor to browse apparel offered in sizes from small through 3X.
cards.short_summary: A family-operated clothing storefront directly on Courthouse Square.
cards.evidence_claim: The visitor bureau places Blushing Beaus Boutique at 8 W. Washington Street and documents women’s apparel in sizes small through 3X.
cards.source_title: Blushing Beaus Boutique - Putnam County Visitor's Bureau
cards.access_notes: Retail storefront; check the business’s current opening hours before making a dedicated trip.

cards.title: Browse Clothing and Home Goods
cards.subtitle: South Indiana Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk the South Indiana Street corridor to browse a Courthouse Square shop carrying clothing, home goods, and crafts.
cards.short_summary: A downtown boutique with both wardrobe and household merchandise.
cards.evidence_claim: The visitor bureau lists Britt’s Blooming Boutique at 21 S. Indiana Street and says it offers clothing, home goods, crafts, and household items.
cards.source_title: Britt's Blooming Boutique - Putnam County Visitor's Bureau
cards.access_notes: Retail storefront; verify current business hours before visiting.

cards.title: Watch the Bakery Kitchen
cards.subtitle: East Walnut Street corridor
cards.notes: Take the East Walnut Street corridor to see the ground-floor bakery kitchen through its surrounding windows.
cards.short_summary: A bakery stop where the production space is part of the streetscape.
cards.evidence_claim: The visitor bureau places BreadWorks at 2 E. Walnut Street and says ground-floor windows provide views into the kitchen and bakers at work.
cards.source_title: BreadWorks by Bridges - Putnam County Visitor's Bureau
cards.access_notes: Food-service business; confirm current operating hours and available seating before visiting.

cards.title: Find an In-House Cobbler Service
cards.subtitle: West Walnut Street corridor
cards.notes: Follow the West Walnut Street corridor to inspect the footwear selection or ask about the shop’s documented repair services.
cards.short_summary: A boot shop that also handles practical shoe and leather repairs.
cards.evidence_claim: The visitor bureau lists Burdge Boots & Boutique at 100 W. Walnut Street and documents cobbler services including soles, heels, lifts, and rip repair.
cards.source_title: Burdge Boots & Boutique - Putnam County Visitor's Bureau
cards.access_notes: Retail and repair shop; contact the business about current hours and repair turnaround times.

cards.title: Choose a Court or Playground
cards.subtitle: South Bloomington Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the South Bloomington Street corridor to reach the park, then choose among courts, playgrounds, shelters, or the amphitheater.
cards.short_summary: A city park offering several recreation options in one named destination.
cards.evidence_claim: The city lists Robe Ann Park at 403 S. Bloomington St. and documents courts, playgrounds, picnic shelters, a ball diamond, and an amphitheater.
cards.access_notes: The city lists park hours as 8:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. daily; individual facilities may follow separate schedules.

cards.title: Trace Putnam County History
cards.subtitle: North Jackson Street corridor
cards.notes: Head up the North Jackson Street corridor to explore exhibits interpreting Putnam County’s natural and cultural history.
cards.short_summary: A county-history destination with exhibitions and a dedicated children’s area.
cards.evidence_claim: The visitor bureau places the Putnam County Museum at 1105 N. Jackson Street and describes its heritage exhibits, programs, and children’s area.
cards.source_title: Putnam County Museum - Putnam County Visitor's Bureau
cards.access_notes: Museum access follows posted operating hours and programming; verify details with the museum before visiting.
